stops.name: Saar-Hunsrück-Steig
stops.detail: A project of the nature park is the 410 km long premium hiking trail Saar-Hunsrück-Steig from Perl on the border with Luxembourg via Mettlach, Weiskirchen and the Roman city of Trier to the Prims Dam, further to the Erbeskopf, the ring wall of Otzenhausen, to the Wildenburger Kopf via Idar-Oberstein to Boppard on the Rhine.
